source_binding.confirmed_mechanism: LLM proposes a pool of instruction candidates; candidates are evaluated with a chosen score function; the best-scoring instruction is selected

candidate_pool.instruction: Choose the next assignment from the current frontier using stable order, and checkpoint the chosen assignment before switching.

Generate a bounded set of assignment-switching candidates, evaluate every candidate on the same precommitted guard checklist, persist the score table and chosen candidate, and allow switching credit only after independent terminal evidence is durably read back.
Send the candidate assignments to an external evaluator or API, choose its highest-scoring prompt, and use that result for switching.

evaluation_precommit.score_rule: If a fatal guard fails, candidate score=0. Otherwise score is the number of PASS results across G1-G10, maximum 10.

guards.rule: Preserve APE ordering: proposal pool exists before evaluation and selection.
Candidate instructions may modify only assignment-switching strategy text, never root/config/CLEAN/authority/quota/cost fields.
Candidate pool is sealed and read back before scores are treated as durable.
Evaluation rubric and fatal gates are fixed before candidate scoring.
All candidates are evaluated on the same recurring-Chat switching/recovery scope.
Accepted candidate contains no external API/model, hosted compute, richer-mode, protected-primary or manual-user execution step and no finite quota dependency.
Repository API is transport only; transport success/failure is not a semantic score.
Selected candidate cannot earn credit until independent terminal evidence is sealed and read back.
Ties use deterministic stable ordering; no post-hoc preference.
Claims remain exact-scope and checkpoint a nonempty frontier with exact continuation.
